title: A gate's host_unchecked reason can be set with backlog.py, and the host word check skips 'host-bound' wording
goal: Found at the SP-d3hybrlv start: ST-pjkmiyqe gate g1 asked who reshapes a story on a host-bound sprint, and start warned that it names a host setup with no --host-check; no backlog.py command sets a gate's host_unchecked reason (only gate add --host-check exists), so the warning could not be answered; SP-evkj4avq met it again on ST-5zpbfax2 gate g1 for host in a url sense. backlog.py gate host-unchecked ID GATE --reason TEXT sets host_unchecked on an existing gate (gate g1), and the host-word check does not fire on host in host-bound, routed host, web host or a url's host, every other use still warning (gate g2).

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); import bl_plan as p; assert not p.HOST_WORDS.search("Should the hook deny WebFetch on a routed host, or only add the route?"); assert not p.HOST_WORDS.search("Who reshapes a story on a host-bound sprint?"); assert p.HOST_WORDS.search("Is the service installed on this host?")

import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; t=tempfile.mkdtemp(); os.makedirs(t+"/kb/_self/backlog"); open(t+"/kb/_self/backlog/ST-testtest.json","w").write(json.dumps({"id":"ST-testtest","kind":"story","title":"t","status":"draft","goal":"g","touches":["x.md"]})); r=lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",t,*a],capture_output=True,text=True); add=lambda g,q: r("gate","add","ST-testtest","--id",g,"--kind","provisional","--question",q,"--option","alpha","--option","beta","--recommendation","alpha"); gates=lambda: json.loads(open(t+"/kb/_self/backlog/ST-testtest.json").read()).get("gates",[]); add("g9","Is the daemon enabled on this host?"); p=r("gate","host-unchecked","ST-testtest","g9","--reason","needs a Windows host"); sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==0 and gates()[0].get("host_unchecked")=="needs a Windows host" else 1)

gates.question: Which command records a gate's host_unchecked reason on an existing gate?
options: gate host-unchecked ID GATE --reason TEXT, beside gate add and gate remove
gates.recommendation: gate host-unchecked ID GATE --reason TEXT, beside gate add and gate remove
gates.answer: gate host-unchecked ID GATE --reason TEXT, beside gate add and gate remove

gates.question: How does the start warning tell a host setup from the word in another sense?
options: skip the word only in the named senses (host-bound, routed host, web host, a url's host); every other use still warns
drop the bare word; only host setup, this host and the host's words warn
gates.recommendation: skip the word only in the named senses (host-bound, routed host, web host, a url's host); every other use still warns
gates.answer: skip the word only in the named senses (host-bound, routed host, web host, a url's host); every other use still warns
